verdict.rationale: First-party docs state compliance teams can configure the equation that calculates customers' risk scores, and can create multiple configurations selected per customer. This covers the 'configure risk factors' half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows an explanation, audit trail or history of why a customer's risk score changed; filtering cases by customer risk is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented risk-score change explanation/history, detail on which risk factors are configurable, independent or hands-on corroboration.
